$$
1, -5, 9, -13, 17, -21, \ldots
$$

The general term is:

$$
a_n = (-1)^{n-1}(4n - 3)
$$

We are asked to find the sum of the first 15 terms, denoted as $ S_{15} $.

- $ n = 1 \Rightarrow a_1 = (-1)^{1-1}(4(1) - 3) = 1 $
- $ n = 2 \Rightarrow a_2 = (-1)^{2-1}(4(2) - 3) = -1 $",
